Purpose: constants and tables for dream/robot/sonic.py, an UNOFFICIAL Python/onnxruntime port of
  gear_sonic_deploy that is NOT verified against the reference C++ binary. tests/test_sonic.py checks
  the port's constants against these files.
Weights are NOT vendored: experiments/fetch_sonic_policy.py downloads nvidia/GEAR-SONIC at the
  revision pinned in experiments/configs/sonic_policy.json into a local cache and verifies the
  SHA-256 (the .onnx hashes are the Hugging Face LFS oids). Weights are licensed by NVIDIA
  Corporation under the NVIDIA Open Model License.
Runtime changes: none to these files.
